description: This file defines the ProposedOrder class used in the Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) system within the OFBiz framework. It models an order proposal with methods to calculate start dates, quantities, and to create requirement entries, integrating with other manufacturing components like BOM (Bill of Materials), routing, and tech data services.

classes.name: ProposedOrder
classes.description: Represents a proposed manufacturing order with methods to calculate start date, quantity, and create requirement entries, based on production type and routing data.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity for the proposed order.

methods.name: getRequirementStartDate
methods.description: Returns the calculated start date for fulfilling the order.

methods.name: calculateStartDate
methods.description: Calculates and updates the requirement start date based on routing, product type, and logistics.

methods.name: calculateQuantityToSupply
methods.description: Adjusts the order quantity based on reorder quantity and other stock considerations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a requirement record in the system for this ProposedOrder.

methods.name: setMrpName
methods.description: Sets the MRP process name associated with this order.
